title: Homeowner's Claim: Insurer Called Storm Damage "Wear and Tear"
description: Bedrock Mutual Insurance denied a roof-damage claim under the policy's wear-and-tear exclusion, contradicting a licensed roofing contractor's inspection report that found wind-driven damage matching a documented storm date.

facts.denialReason: Denied under the policy's wear-and-tear exclusion, Section 6.3
facts.disputedFinding: Bedrock Mutual attributed the roof damage to gradual wear and tear rather than storm impact.
facts.inspectionSource: Highline Roofing & Restoration, licensed contractor report dated 2026-06-25
facts.inspectionFinding: The inspection found wind-driven granule loss and impact fractures consistent with the June 18, 2026 storm, not gradual wear.
